answer: In a decentralized AI economy, the Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) consensus mechanism can resist fake-identity attacks by maintaining a thread of accountability among agents. Each agent is assigned a unique identifier, akin to an island, to prevent Sybil attacks. As agents interact, their transactions create a ripple effect, allowing the network to detect and flag suspicious activity, ultimately identifying and penalizing fake agents, thereby maintaining the integrity of the economy.
